newsitem.title: FRANCE: AGF rallies, takeover talk revives.
newsitem.headline: AGF rallies, takeover talk revives.

text.p: Shares in French insurer AGF gained strongly in Friday morning trading on the Paris bourse, helped by renewed speculation on its future as well as its imminent entry into the CAC-40 leading share index, analysts said.
The share was up 2.91 percent at 205.0 francs at 1132 GMT, while the CAC-40 was down 0.18 percent, with more than 400,000 shares traded.
"The share is feeling the full effect of its imminent entry into the CAC-40, as investors will want to have index shares in their portfolios," said one major brokerage analyst.
Others also cited recurring speculation about the insurer's future.

Munich bank Merck, Finck & Co published a study on Thursday in which it said the moment could be right for German insurer Allianz AG to takeover AGF, Europe's eighth largest insurer, given its share price and earnings outlook.
One analyst at a large French bank noted said: "the ideal moment to buy would have been six months ago when the share stood at around 130 francs".
